title: Total quantity sold per product with zero for none
prompt: Return every product's name (as name) along with the total quantity sold (as total_quantity). Include products that have never been sold, showing 0 instead of NULL for their total_quantity.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE prod10 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO prod10 VALUES (1,'Widget'),(2,'Gadget'),(3,'Gizmo'),(4,'Doohickey'); CREATE TABLE sale10 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER, quantity INTEGER); INSERT INTO sale10 VALUES (1,1,5),(2,1,3),(3,2,10);
reference_sql: SELECT prod10.name, COALESCE(SUM(sale10.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM prod10 LEFT JOIN sale10 ON prod10.id = sale10.product_id GROUP BY prod10.id, prod10.name;
